items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Then I formed a band with them in it, with Ray and Webster and . . .

ctx.x: Lincoln Ballroom at this time, before Lincoln Center. Lincoln Ballroom. It had Ben Webster, Dexter Gordon, Charlie Parker. I saw Sonny Stitt, Red Rodney, Fats Navarro, all these names on there that I was seeing on these recordings. Of course Bird’s name stood out. So I got down there that day. It was Sunday. Lowell got in, because he looked older than me. Paid his $2 and went in. I was on line. I put my $2 up, and the guy said, “How old are you?” I said, [McLean hesitates] “I’m . . . 19.” “Man, get out of here.”…
